Who I am

A short intro

AI Engineer focused on Deep Learning, Computer Vision, Generative AI and Agentic AI — turning research into intelligent, scalable, real‑world systems. I'm a senior AI student at Misr University for Science and Technology (MUST), an AI/ML Instructor at Google Developer Groups on Campus, and a Sprints Ambassador, where I mentor aspiring engineers and simplify complex AI concepts for the community.

My work spans the full AI lifecycle — from data collection and preprocessing to training, optimizing and deploying models — with hands‑on depth in CNNs, Vision Transformers, EfficientNet and Transfer Learning. Right now my main focus is Generative AI & Agentic AI: building LLM‑powered apps, RAG pipelines, and autonomous agents that can reason, plan and act. I pair all of it with a genuine passion for UI/UX & HCI — because powerful AI only matters if people can actually use it.

🧠 Deep Learning 👁 Computer Vision ✨ Generative AI 🤖 Agentic AI 📊 Data Analytics 🎨 UI/UX & HCI
